Business-type: proprietary Total column; nonoperating 'State Revolving Fund And Bond Proceeds' 287,315 recorded as business_type.debt_proceeds, outside the operating receipts total (531,269.24). Roll-forward business: 701,640.71 + 531,269.24 - 818,113.75 + 287,315 = 702,111.20. Governmental transfers in and out are both 6,000 (printed after Total Receipts / Total Disbursements). Balance sheet is the cash-basis Statement of Net Position, Total column (governmental -179,731.11 + business-type 702,111.20). General Fund combining schedules p11-12 show only the General, Community Center and RV Park columns (other columns, e.g. Parks & Recreation, Bradshaw Days, TIF, are on pages not in the trimmed PDF); detail covers those three. General fund detail is a breakdown of the same governmental totals, not additional. Street Fund budget line 'Miscellaneous' disbursement has budget 119,400 with no actual printed; omitted. Budget amounts in General fund disbursement schedule and proprietary schedule are only given as fund totals or combined proprietary, so budget_final is null for those lines. Proprietary budget schedule detail lists per-fund columns (Electric, Water, Sewer) and repeats Exhibit IV by fund; Nonoperating state revolving fund/bond proceeds shown as other financing (Electric 260,000; Water 27,315), outside the printed operating totals. Cash-basis categories for Vehicle Expenses/Repair split by dominant fund. Read pages 1-18 of 18.
